description: Unzip files. Get the files out of an archive. Paths like "../.." are defused, and an archive that expands out of all proportion to its size is refused. Accepts application/zip, application/x-zip-compressed, .zip; up to 100 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: archive_unzip
